items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: Well, if you see my friend Allen Tinney, tell him hello.

ctx.x: Well we’ve enjoyed talking with you very much. If you have any last things you’d like to say that I haven’t thought of —
Well, if you see my friend Allen Tinney, tell him hello. I think he’s in Buffalo now.
Umm — that’s not far from us.
